source: Lecture on the nature of magic by Archmage Tarelion.
target: 大法师泰尔兰关于魔法本质的演讲。

deep_observation: “won't do you any favors tomorrow morning”是在暗示掺入的烈性好料会让人次晨难受，译为“明天早上对你没什么用”误成届时无效；“put a bit ... in this one”也被改成了“带来个好东西”，丢失向这瓶药剂中掺入少量东西的关系。
source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The dwarf finally returns with a vial and a small pouch.*#WHITE#
I put a bit of the good stuff in this one, though it won't do you any favors tomorrow morning. And careful with that Taint of Purging, especially if the wife answers the door the next time you knock. Har!
surface_observation: 标点格式破坏：中文译文内混入半角逗号（“清除印记”,如果），其余分句均为全角标点
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*那个矮人终于回来了，手里拿着一个药瓶和一个小袋子。*#WHITE#
这里面我给你带来个好东西，尽管也许明天早上对你没什么用。小心使用这个“清除印记”,如果下次你敲门的时候，是我老婆开门的话，你可要小心点，哈！

deep_observation: “glowing robes”指会发光的长袍，译为“鲜艳长袍”仅表示色彩鲜明，改变了明确的发光特征。
source: An elf dressed in glowing robes.
surface_observation: 明显错译：source 的 glowing robes（发光的长袍）被译为“鲜艳长袍”，丢失 glowing 语义
target: 一位穿着鲜艳长袍的精灵。

source: Entrance to some ancient elven ruins
Surround yourself with Wildfire, increasing all your fire damage by %0.1f%%, ignoring %d%% fire resistance of your targets and reducing self-inflicted fire damage by %d%%.
surface_observation:
格式破坏：source 为单行，译文擅自插入换行与制表符 
		，改变了 tformat 描述的渲染排版
target:
使身上缠绕火焰，增加 %0.1f%% 所有火系伤害并无视目标 %d%% 火焰抗性。
		同时，减少 %d%% 对自己造成的火焰伤害。

source: The target is poisoned, taking %0.2f blight damage per turn and decreasing all heals received by %d%%.
target: 目标中毒，每回合受到 %0.2f 枯萎伤害并降低所有治疗效果 %d%%。
这个傀儡遭受过严重的破坏。

deep_observation: 固定源码中该实体是 stone golem，描述明确称其为“animated statue”；“活化傀儡”把雕像改成傀儡，丢失其石质雕像这一实体性质。
source: It is a massive animated statue.
surface_observation: 明显错译：source 的 statue（雕像）被译为“傀儡”（golem），与同批 golem 条目术语冲突且丢失 statue 语义

deep_observation: “ethereal blue”结合已鉴定名 Spectral Cage 及“ghostly forms”描述表示幽灵般的蓝色；“天蓝色”误成普通的天空蓝，丢失幽灵、虚幻特征。
surface_observation: 明显错译/漏译：ethereal blue lantern 的 ethereal（幽冥/缥缈）被丢弃，译为“天蓝色的灯笼”仅剩颜色义

source:
While shrouded in cursed miasma you gain stealth (%d power) and %d physical power.
		The stealth power and physical power will increase with your mindpower.
target:
当你被包裹在诅咒瘴气中时，你获得潜行 (%d 强度)，并获得 %d 物理强度。
		潜行强度和物理强度受精神强度加成。

source: Light gloves which do not seriously hinder finger movements, while still protecting the hands somewhat.
target: 轻便的手套不仅不影响手指的活动，还会多多少少保护手的安全。

source:
Conjures up a bolt of lightning, doing %0.2f to %0.2f damage (%0.2f average) and dazing the target for 3 turns.
		If the target resists the daze effect it is instead shocked, which halves stun/daze/pin resistance, for 5 turns.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
召唤一道闪电，对目标造成 %0.2f ～ %0.2f 闪电伤害（平均 %0.2f），并使其眩晕 3 回合。
		如果目标抵抗了眩晕效果，则转而受到“震撼”效果，震慑、眩晕和定身抗性减半，持续 5 回合。
		伤害随法术强度提高。

source: The target is immune to further damage but is dealing %d%% less damage.
target: 目标免疫伤害，但造成的伤害减少 %d%%。

source:
Surround yourself with a myriad of tiny, nearly invisible, reinforcing fungi.
		You gain %d maximum life and %d life regeneration.
		The effects will increase with your Willpower.
target:
使你自身周围环绕无数微不可见、有治疗作用的孢子。
		你获得 %d 最大生命值，%d 生命回复。
		效果受意志值加成。

source: He points in the direction of the Riljek forest to the north.
target: 他指着北方的里尔约克森林。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#Go at once to Last Hope to report those events!
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#立刻到最后的希望汇报所发生的情况！

source: #CRIMSON##Source# shares some damage with a shadow!
#LIGHT_RED#%s writhes in agony as a fragment of its mind is destroyed!
target: #LIGHT_RED#%s痛苦地扭动着，它的一片精神碎片被摧毁了！

source: This power seems too much to wield; you fear it might absorb YOU.
target: 这件装备的力量太强大了，你害怕它会把你吸收进去。

source:
Fire a shot at the target tile that blinds enemies for %d turns, marks them for 2 turns and illuminates the area within radius %d for %d turns. Enemies within the illuminated area lose %d defence and stealth power and cannot benefit from concealment.
		The status chance increases with your Accuracy, and the defense reduction with your Dexterity.
target:
发射闪光弹，致盲敌人 %d 回合，标记他们 2 回合并照亮 %d 格范围 %d 回合。范围内的敌人降低 %d 闪避和潜行强度，不能从隐匿技能得到任何加成。
		状态效果几率受命中加成，闪避削减受敏捷加成。

source: Unique (fixed) bosses advance in bonus classes 30% faster
target: 独有（固定）Boss 的额外职业等级提升速度快 30%

A shroud of darkness seems to fall across your path.

#CRIMSON# 强度 1+：%s 暗夜行者：%+d 暗影抗性，%+d%% 最大暗影抗性，%+d 看破隐形强度

deep_observation: “bellow”意为低沉吼声，而“无尽深渊”表达 endless abyss，不对应原名“The Deep Bellow”的核心名词和意象。
surface_observation: 实体名 The Deep Bellow（bellow=吼声/号角轰鸣，该物品为号角）被误译为「无尽深渊」，将 Bellow 当作 below/深渊处理，属明显错译

source: This helmet radiates a dark power. Its visor seems to twist and corrupt the vision of its wearer. You feel worried that if you were to lower it for long, the visions may affect your mind.
target: 这顶头盔散发着黑暗的力量。它似乎能够扭曲和腐化装备者的视觉。你担心如果长时间放下护面，那些幻象可能会影响你的心智。

source: Dwarves are a secretive people, hailing from their underground home of the Iron Throne.
target: 矮人是一支隐秘的种族，生活于地下世界钢铁王座。

deep_observation: 首句明确造成 darkness damage，译文仅称“伤害”，遗漏黑暗伤害类型；末句“+%d%% damage”又译成“+%d%% 点伤害”，错误地给百分比增伤添加点数单位。
source:
Sends a torrent of searing darkness through your foes, doing %d darkness damage. There is a 25%% chance the rushing darkness will blind them for 3 turns and cause them to lose track of their target.
		If you know the Creeping Darkness talent, a short-lived trail of darkness is left in the beam's wake. Its damage is identical to that of Creeping Darkness's.
		The damage will increase with your Mindpower. You do +%d%% damage to anything that has entered your creeping dark.
surface_observation: 首段后续行缩进由源文 \n\t\t 改为 \n\t\t\t，比源文多一个制表符，缩进格式与源文不一致
target:
向敌人发射一股灼热的黑暗能量，造成 %d 点伤害。黑暗能量有 25%% 概率致盲目标 3 回合并使它们丢失当前目标。
			如果你掌握黑暗之雾技能，会在射线范围内留下短暂的黑暗尾迹，其伤害等同于黑暗之雾的伤害。
			伤害受精神强度加成。你对任何进入黑暗之雾的人造成 +%d%% 点伤害。
